posts.text: While postpartum psychosis and depression are the trendiest phrases on the Internet, maybe we should be normalizing motherhood as one of the most beautiful journeys you could ever embrace. How blessed we are to get to grow new life from scratch, share our bodies with tiny kicking feet, look our babies in the eyes for the first time, experience a depth of love never previously possible, and turn love for our spouses into new life. There is perhaps nothing more sacred or worth pursuing.
